context:
Goal: reviews end as soon as a change is proven safe.
Problem (rule): R9 keeps round 3 for a guard or check change that failed a round and was fixed under a fix check. At 11:40 CST you asked 'do we still force round 3 reviews on certain items? ... that shouldnt be teh case anymore', which may mean you want this case dropped too. It needs your word.
Based on (ruling): R9 (your 15:44 CST Nov 10, pick 471 a); decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3.
Based on (measured): round 3 found a failure 0 of 14+ times after a clean round 2; the net-value hold caught 6 real holes (plan R9).
Departs from: main — a fixed guard change waits for round 3; b ends it at the passing fix check.
Meanwhile: lanes follow R9 as written; the coordinator tells every active lane that a clean round 1 is done.
home: ruling R9 (pick 471 a); decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3; step role-texts-match-rulings

reply: Closed 12:32 CST Nov 13: the retrospective withdrew it. R9 (your 15:44 CST Nov 10, pick 471 a) already rules it: a guard or check change that passes round 1 is done; only one fixed under a fix check waits for round 3. Your 11:40 CST words are covered by that: the coordinator told every lane a clean round 1 is done. Reopen if you want round 3 dropped for the fixed case too.
